t: What happens when it is said sincerely
a: مَا قَالَ عَبْدٌ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ قَطُّ مُخْلِصًا إِلاَّ فُتِحَتْ لَهُ أَبْوَابُ السَّمَاءِ حَتَّى تُفْضِيَ إِلَى الْعَرْشِ مَا اجْتَنَبَ الْكَبَائِرَ
p: Mā qāla ʿabdun lā ilāha illā-Llāhu qaṭṭu mukhliṣan illā futiḥat lahu abwābu-s-samāʾi ḥattā tufḍiya ilā-l-ʿarsh, mā-jtanaba-l-kabāʾir
m: No servant ever says there is no god but Allah sincerely without the gates of the sky being opened for it until it reaches the Throne, as long as he avoids the major sins.
